privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.body:
This privacy notice explains how Eden Ridge collects and uses the information you provide through this website.

What we collect. When you submit an enquiry we collect your name, email address, telephone number where given, the nature of your interest, and any message you write. We also record the page you enquired from and basic technical information such as your browser type. Your IP address is stored only as an irreversible hash, used to limit automated abuse.

Why we collect it. We use this information solely to respond to your enquiry, to send you the information pack or video walkthrough you requested, and to keep a record of our correspondence with you.

Who we share it with. We do not sell your information. It is accessible to the Eden Ridge sales team and to the email provider that delivers our messages.

How long we keep it. Enquiry records are retained for as long as needed to serve you as a prospective buyer. You may ask us to delete your record at any time.

Your rights. You may request a copy of the information we hold about you, ask us to correct it, or ask us to erase it. Contact us using the details on the enquiry section of this site.

Cookies. This site sets no advertising cookies. If website analytics are enabled, a consent banner will appear before any analytics cookie is set.

This notice is provided as a starting point and should be reviewed by the developer's legal adviser before launch.

terms.title: Terms & Disclaimer
terms.body:
By using this website you accept the terms set out below.

Indicative material. All images, renders, illustrations, floor plans, dimensions and specifications shown on this site are for indicative purposes only. They do not form part of any offer or contract and may not represent the finished residence.

Changes. The developer reserves the right to amend specifications, plans, layouts, finishes and details as necessary and without prior notice.

Pricing and availability. Prices, payment structures, reservation amounts and unit availability are subject to change. Figures shown are correct at the time of publication only. Please contact the sales team for current pricing.

No offer. Nothing on this website constitutes an offer, an invitation to treat, or financial or investment advice. Any purchase is governed solely by the executed sale and purchase agreement.

Third-party content. Renders are produced by Blueprint 3D Studios. Where this site links to third-party services, we are not responsible for their content or privacy practices.

These terms are provided as a starting point and should be reviewed by the developer's legal adviser before launch.
